Options.Description.ExportVectorFormat: The file format for vector geospatial files.
Options.Description.ExportGeoTiffFormat: The file format for GeoTIFF files. **Int16** is the default option, which provides a reasonable ratio between the details and the file size. **Float32** includes extra information in decimals, but the file size is twice as big. **Norm16** normalizes Int16's data and can be re-imported to the asset editor.
Options.Description.ExportButton: Export in-game objects as geospatial files.
Options.Description.SystemArea: The area features, which includes districts and map tiles.
Options.Description.SystemBuilding: The building features, which includes buildings, specialized industries, and landfills.
Options.Description.SystemNetwork: The network features, which includes roads, tracks, paths, etc.
Options.Description.FeatureTrack: The tram, subway, and train tracks.
Options.Description.SystemPOI: The point of interest (POI) features, which includes buildings, traffic lights, transportation stops, etc.
Options.Description.FeaturePOIPrivate: The POIs of shops and factories.
Options.Description.FeaturePOIPublic: The POIs of public facilities, such as police stations and fire stations. See also the "Utility Facility POI" option for public infrasturues, such as power plants and water pumping stations.
Options.Description.FeaturePOITransport: The POIs of transportation services, such as bus stops and train stations.
Options.Description.FeaturePOIUtility: The POIs of public infrasturues, such as power plants and water pumping stations. See also the "Public Facility POI" option for public facilities, such as police stations and fire stations.
Options.Description.SystemRoute: The transport route features, which includes public and cargo routes.
Options.Description.FeatureTerrain: The grayscale map of the terrain.
Options.Description.FeatureWater: The grayscale map of the water bodies.
Options.Description.PropertiesSystemSele: Select the feature type you want to configure.
Options.Description.GeometryBoundary: Exports the outer boundary of the object.
Options.Description.GeometryCenterline: Exports the centerlines of networks or transport routes.
Options.Description.GeometryFootprint: Exports the ground coverage area of buildings.
Options.Description.GeometryLocation: Exports the spatial location of the object.
Options.Description.GeometryAirPollution: Exports the distribution of airborne pollution.
Options.Description.GeometryDepth: Exports the depth of water bodies.
Options.Description.GeometryFertileDepos: Exports the distribution of fertile lands.
Options.Description.GeometryFlowDirectio: Exports the direction of surface water flow.
Options.Description.GeometryFlowSpeed: Exports the velocity of surface water flow.
Options.Description.GeometryGroundPollut: Exports pollution levels present in the soil.
Options.Description.GeometryGroundWaterD: Exports the distribution of the groundwater.
Options.Description.GeometryNoisePolluti: Exports the distribution of the noise pollution.
Options.Description.GeometryOilDeposit: Exports the distribution of the crude oil deposit.
Options.Description.GeometryOreDeposit: Exports the distribution of the ore deposit.
Options.Description.GeometryWoodDeposit: Exports the distribution of wood (forest) resources.
Options.Description.GeometryWorldDepth: Exports the depth of water bodies from the world map.
Options.Description.GeometryWorldElevati: Exports the terrain elevation data from the world map.
Options.Description.SourceCRS: The coordinate reference system (CRS) used for input coordinates.
Options.Description.SourceXCoord: The X value of the coordinate. For WGS84, this is the longitude in decimal degrees; for UTM and other Transverse Mercator systems, it's the easting in meters.
Options.Description.SourceYCoord: The Y value of the coordinate. For WGS84, this is the latitude in decimal degrees; for UTM and other Transverse Mercator systems, it's the northing in meters.
Options.Description.SourceHemisphere: Specifies whether the coordinate is in the Northern or Southern Hemisphere.
Options.Description.SourceUTMZone: The UTM zone number for the coordinate location. Valid values range from 1 to 60.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoid: The reference ellipsoid used for the Transverse Mercator projection.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoidSemiM: Length of the semi-major axis of the ellipsoid, in meters.
Options.Description.SourceEllipsoidInver: The inverse flattening (1/f) of the ellipsoid.
Options.Description.SourceCRSOriginLongi: Longitude of the projection origin in WGS84 decimal degrees, also called the central meridian.
Options.Description.SourceCRSOriginLatit: Latitude of the projection origin in WGS84 decimal degrees.
Options.Description.SourceCRSFalseEastin: Offset added to the X-axis (easting) in meters.
Options.Description.SourceCRSFalseNorthi: Offset added to the Y-axis (northing) in meters.
Options.Description.SourceCRSScaleFactor: A scale factor applied to distances from the origin. Typically slightly less than 1.
Options.Description.SourceCRSTransform: Helmert Transform parameters for converting the current datum to WGS84. Enter values separated by spaces.
Options.Description.OutputElevation: Includes the elevation (z-value) for each coordinate in the export. **Note: This may significantly increase the file size.**
Options.Description.OutputMinimizedGeoJS: Removes unnecessary whitespace and line breaks from the GeoJSON output to reduce file size. **Note: Some GIS tools may have trouble reading minimized files.**
Options.Description.GeometryInactiveRout: Exports the routes that are currently disabled.
Options.Description.GeometrySeparateServ: Exports service upgrade buildings as separate POIs.
Options.Description.GeometryUnzoned: Exports zoning cells even if they are unzoned. **Note: This may greatly increase the file size depending on the save data.**
Options.Description.PropertyGeneralHomel: Includes the count of homeless households and residents in the export.
Options.Description.PropertyGeneralMapTi: Generates statistical data for each map tile. **Note: Disabling this option will produce results compatible with version 0.*.**
Options.Description.PropertyCategoryBuil: Selects the display mode for the category fields of the building features. **All** is the default option, which assigns all applicable categories to each feature, separated with a comma. **Single** assigns one category to each feature, and if there are multiple categories applicable to the feature, only the best category will be assigned.
Options.Description.PropertyCategoryNetw: Selects the display mode for the category fields of the network features. **All** is the default option, which assigns all applicable categories to each feature, separated with a comma. **Single** assigns one category to each feature, and if there are multiple categories applicable to the feature, only the best category will be assigned.
Options.Description.PropertyCategoryPOID: Selects the display mode for the category fields of the POI features. **All** is the default option, which assigns all applicable categories to each feature, separated with a comma. **Single** assigns one category to each feature, and if there are multiple categories applicable to the feature, only the best category will be assigned.
Options.Option.PropertyColorZcc: Color: Use Zone Color Changer Colors
Options.Description.PropertyColorZcc: Replaces zoning color values with those defined by the Zone Color Changer.
Options.Description.PropertyPassengerPet: Adds the number of pets transported on the route to the total passenger count.
Options.Description.PropertyResidentSepa: Breaks down resident counts by gender (male and female).
Options.Option.PropertyThemeAssetPack: Theme: Treat Asset Packs as Themes
Options.Description.PropertyThemeAssetPa: Categorizes assets from the same asset pack under a shared theme field.
Options.Description.PropertyWageTaxable: Exports the average taxable income instead of the gross income for each statistical unit .
Options.Description.PropertyZoningDispla: Selects the display mode for the zoning fields of all features. **All** is the default option, which assigns all applicable categories to each feature, separated with a comma. **Single** assigns one category to each feature, and if there are multiple categories applicable to the feature, only the best category will be assigned.
